verdict: Paid ads remain off; organic visibility is now falling too.

Reactivating paid campaigns is the immediate priority to restore lead flow, and your Google Business Profile presence is being reviewed to address the sudden engagement decline. Expect lead generation to remain minimal until paid activity resumes.
